subject: Action plan: phased runtime onboarding for live outputs & tool calls
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-31T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Action plan: phased runtime onboarding for live outputs & tool calls

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call today. I wanted to capture a concise, phased approach we discussed so we have clear owners and success criteria. High level: we’ll run a staged rollout that validates streaming output correctness and structured JSON schemas first, then add function/tool-calling hooks and finally sign off for production traffic.

Proposed phases (high level):
- Phase 0 (now–Nov 5): environment & access — staging cluster, API keys, and network allowlist.
- Phase 1 (Nov 6–Nov 16): streaming + schema validation. Partner provides sample payloads; we run automated schema conformance checks and manual spot checks.
- Phase 2 (Nov 17–Nov 25): function/tool calling integration — define tool contracts, security review, and test runbooks.
- Phase 3 (Nov 26–Dec 3): gradual production traffic ramp (canary), rollback plan, and CS playbook handoff.

Asks for Aurora:
1) Provide a representative JSON sample set (10–20 items) and one end-to-end example for a successful tool call by Nov 6.
2) Confirm if data residency or private deployment is required for Phase 3 so we can provision Dedicated or Private options.
3) Share any compliance evidence the security team needs early (SOC 2 in particular).

Attachments: phased_onboarding_template.xlsx (timeline + owners), runtime_requirements.md (runtime capacity & model variants).

I’m copying Mina (CS), Laura (Enablement) — they’ll coordinate the handshake and docs. I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week (Nov 3) to align owners.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@aurorahealth.com>

Date: 2027-11-01T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action plan: phased runtime onboarding for live outputs & tool calls

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear phases. A few notes from Aurora’s side:
- Timeline looks good; Nov 6 for initial schema validation is acceptable.
- We may require Private deployment for Phase 3 due to PHI in some payloads; I’ve looped in security@aurorahealth.com.
- Security team will want: SOC 2 Type II report, list of data retention defaults, and audit log retention policy. Can you confirm where those live?
- We’ll send sample payloads by Nov 5. Also adding a request: can Redwood provide a short runbook snippet that shows how a tool-call failure is surfaced to our SREs?

I’ve also included our platform engineering alias to confirm API allowlist format and any CIDR exceptions.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director, Platform Engineering | Aurora Health
samira.k@aurorahealth.com

Quick technical notes for the team and Aurora platform engineers:
- Staging cluster is available: staging.redwood.ai (credentials + jump instructions attached; see staging-access-instructions.txt).
- We recommend starting streaming tests with max_seq_length=1024 and target batch_size=8 for latency-sensitive paths; we can relax batching later for throughput.
- We’ll enable prefix/KV caching for repeat sessions to reduce token cost; note that cache warm-up needs ~200 warm requests for useful hit rates on typical Aurora traffic.
- For function/tool calling: define a contract schema for the tool response (status, id, payload). We can enforce via schema-gated validators in Phase 2.
- If Aurora needs Private deployment, we can provision a VPC-connected Private control plane; lead time 7–10 business days once approved.

Attaching: staging-access-instructions.txt (attachment stub).

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Staff Inference Engineer | Redwood Inference
